title: Ivory River — Agent Commerce
description: Search, configure, quote, recommend gaming PCs and components. Hands user to in-browser checkout.
summary: Search, configure, quote, recommend gaming PCs and components. Hands user to in-browser checkout.
offersHint: Search, configure, quote, recommend gaming PCs and components. Hands user to in-browser checkout. · Remote MCP (sse) at https://mcp.ivoryriver.store/sse

toolsPreview.name: search_products
toolsPreview.description: Search the Ivory River catalog with semantic + keyword hybrid ranking. Use for natural-language queries like "rtx 5090 laptop under $3000" or "case for AM5 build with tempered glass".

toolsPreview.name: get_product
toolsPreview.description: Get full detail for a single product by ID. Includes price, stock, attributes, and (for BYOPC builds) a configurator summary.

toolsPreview.name: list_builds
toolsPreview.description: List the four BYOPC tiers (Squire, Knight, DragonSlayer, Archangel) with their base prices and aggregate component summaries. Use this to overview what custom-build options exist before drilling into a specific tier.

toolsPreview.name: list_build_options
toolsPreview.description: Pull the full configurator schema for a single BYOPC tier: every field (Processor, Motherboard, GPU, RAM, Storage, etc.) with all child product options including price, stock, and IDs. Use this to see what selections are available before quoting.

toolsPreview.name: quote_build
toolsPreview.description: Itemize a configured BYOPC build: returns line totals + grand total + pairwise compatibility check. Empty selections are valid -- the server auto-fills the cheapest in-stock option for any required field.

toolsPreview.name: check_compatibility
toolsPreview.description: Pairwise socket / DDR / form-factor compatibility check between two products. Returns { compatible, reason }. Use before recommending a CPU + motherboard pairing or RAM + motherboard.

toolsPreview.name: recommend_build
toolsPreview.description: Recommend BYOPC desktop tiers, optionally filtered by budget. `use_case` is informational (echoed in metadata) and helps the agent reason; the result is sorted by total ascending. For laptop recommendations, call search_products with category="laptops" instead.

toolsPreview.name: get_aivy_handoff_link
toolsPreview.description: Build the URL the agent hands to the user to finalize a recommendation. Lands the user on ivoryriver.store with the chat widget auto-opened, the agent's recommendation pre-staged, and quick-reply chips: [Yes, add to cart] [Show me the breakdown] [Modify components]. Use this AFTER you've recommended a build (via recommend_build / list_build_options / quote_build) and the user wants to proceed. The user always finishes the purchase in the browser; you never check out.
